why_it_fails: Both license channels of the correct branch are complete/grade A on every run - the menu is NOT failing. Not "fresh": last_success 2026-10-19T03:02Z = 17.3 h at 20:22Z. FRESHNESS: storage.py (~L420) counts a store fresh only if an accepted endpoint succeeded <12 h ago. Newest attempt of any kind in the whole DB is 2026-10-19T05:24Z; investigated 2026-10-19T20:22Z. Scheduler (main.py create_app: APScheduler menu-sync 4/day at 00/06/12/18 America/Chicago, only while uvicorn runs) enqueues only live_settings.active_region_id = ad41b2e9 ("Browser GPS", 50 mi around 40.98,-89.05); the last scheduled job ran 05:00Z (00:00 CDT) and the 06:00/12:00 CDT slots never ran (server not up). Chicago is ~95 mi from the scheduled region centre (98.7 from the study centre) and only ever refreshed by manual region-8f7772ca/targeted jobs (7c60df34). Second issue: 2 sibling-branch endpoints (Antioch 5683, Marion 1688) attached via the chain nav (same defect as Oakbrook Terrace: adapters.py resolve_menu L262 has no branch_slug_conflict guard, and site_discovery._slug_candidates cannot parse "/dispensaries/illinois-<city>/"). They are rejected by jane.py (distance guard) so they do not pollute offers, but waste attempts every sync until superseded (commit 459b386 handles it from the next fetch). The correct branch only passes jane.py because the endpoint carries identity_confidence "matched" (address on page) - the Jane point is 1.31 mi from the registry point (> MAX_MILES 0.35). The sampler false negative (0 items) is that missing merged identity_confidence, not a broken menu.
fix_idea: Same shared fixes as Consume Oakbrook Terrace: _slug_candidates support for /dispensaries/<state>-<city>/, branch_slug_conflict guard at adapters.py L262, a Consume CONNECTORS entry, and scheduler coverage of all regions with retained endpoints (or refreshing by endpoint age). No per-store change needed.
